items.source: Server-side only alternative to read(ResolvableType, ReactiveHttpInputMessage, Map) with additional context available.
items.translation: 服务器端仅替代方案，提供额外上下文： read(ResolvableType, ReactiveHttpInputMessage, Map)

items.source: Server-side only alternative to readMono(ResolvableType, ReactiveHttpInputMessage, Map) with additional, context available.
items.translation: 服务器端仅替代方案，提供额外上下文： readMono(ResolvableType, ReactiveHttpInputMessage, Map)

items.source: elementType - the type of objects in the stream which must have been previously checked via canRead(ResolvableType, MediaType)
items.translation: elementType - 流中对象的类型，该类型必须已通过canRead(ResolvableType, MediaType)预先检查。

items.source: the decoded stream of elements
items.translation: 解码后的元素流

items.source: Return the list of media types supported by this reader. The list may not apply to every possible target element type and calls to this method should typically be guarded via canWrite(elementType, null). The list may also exclude media types supported only for a specific element type. Alternatively, use getReadableMediaTypes(ResolvableType) for a more precise list.
items.translation: 返回此读取器支持的媒体类型列表。该列表可能不适用于所有可能的目标元素类型，因此调用此方法通常应通过 canWrite(elementType, null) 进行防护。该列表也可能仅包含特定元素类型支持的媒体类型。或者，使用 getReadableMediaTypes(ResolvableType) 获取更精确的列表。

items.source: Return the list of media types supported by this Reader for the given type of element. This list may differ from getReadableMediaTypes() if the Reader doesn't support the element type, or if it supports it only for a subset of media types.
items.translation: 返回此 Reader 支持给定元素类型的媒体类型列表。如果 Reader 不支持该元素类型，或仅支持其子集的媒体类型，则该列表可能与 getReadableMediaTypes() 不同。

items.source: Whether the given object type is supported by this reader.
items.translation: 给定对象类型是否由该读取器支持。

items.source: Read from the input message and decode to a stream of objects.
items.translation: 从输入消息中读取并解码为对象流。

items.source: Read from the input message and decode to a single object.
items.translation: 从输入消息中读取并解码为单个对象。

items.source: actualType - the actual type of the target method parameter; for annotated controllers, the MethodParameter can be accessed via ResolvableType.getSource().
items.translation: actualType - 目标方法参数的实际类型；对于带注解的控制器，可以通过ResolvableType.getSource()访问 MethodParameter。
